Takao Umehara · Creative Director · Design & AI Executiveクリエイティブディレクター · デザインと AI · New York ↔ Japanニューヨーク ↔ 日本

Creative leadership, across mediums媒体をまたいで、つくる

Different medium. Same instinct.媒体は違っても、勘は同じ。

A brand film told through real New York creatives. A room full of phones drawing on one wall. A festival rebuilt from scratch around games. A design organisation working with AI agents. They look unrelated. They are the same move: find the real question, make it tangible early, and let people react to it.ニューヨークのクリエイターたちが語るブランドフィルム。部屋中のスマホがひとつの壁に描く体験。ゲームを軸にゼロから作り直した祭り。AI エージェントと働くデザイン組織。無関係に見えて、動きは同じ。本当の問いを見つけ、早く形にして、人の反応を見る。

I like the beginning of things — the part where the idea is still soft and needs someone to make it real enough to react to.はじまりが好きだ。アイデアがまだ柔らかく、誰かが手で触れる形にしないと先へ進まない段階。

Reimagining how product teams make decisions with AIAI による UX ワークフローの変革

Verizon Value (6 brands) · Lead Product Designer (Agentic UX & AI Systems) · 2025–present

Working inside hard constraints — no custom models, no API access, Gemini and NotebookLM only — as a design brief. Agents authored as small filesystems of workflow, definition and knowledge files; Figma wired to code through MCP so prototypes stay on the real design system.独自モデルも API 接続もない制約を、設計条件にした。エージェントは手順・定義・知識の小さなファイル群として書いた。Figma は MCP でコードとつなぎ、試作が設計基盤から外れないようにした。

10
agents designed and shippedエージェント 10 体を実装
40+
designers using the agents利用デザイナー 40 人超
What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • 16+ one-hour interviews with designers and strategists; transcripts clustered with NotebookLM into a searchable pain map
  • Effort × impact × opportunity prioritisation and selection of bets with leadership
  • Designed and built all ten agents: Master Brain (3-layer project knowledge hub), Justin Case (edge-case detector), Sally (CX strategist / heuristic evaluator), the five-agent WDS studio, Clara (UX-writing evaluator), Alex (agent architect)
  • Authored agents as filesystems of workflow, definition and knowledge files; iterated each 'Gem' version after version
  • Wired Figma to VS Code via MCP so AI prototypes run on real design-system code
  • Weekly hands-on workshops for ~40 designers; every agent shared live

What the team didチームがしたこと

  • The XM product-strategy team took ownership of Master Brain and ran it across multiple real projects
  • Design leadership selected which bets to pilot
  • Designers, PMs, researchers and content people adopted the agents in their own projects
